description: Standardized skill dictionary with aliases for normalization and rule-based learning curriculum.

skills.name: JavaScript
learning_recommendations: Modern ES6+ syntax (arrow functions, destructuring, promises, async/await)
DOM manipulation and event-driven asynchronous architecture
Closures, prototypes, and event loop mechanics

skills.name: Python
learning_recommendations: Core Python syntax, list comprehensions, generators, and decorators
Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) in Python and package management
Python standard library and popular external packages (NumPy, Requests, FastAPI)

skills.name: Java
learning_recommendations: Core Java syntax, JVM architecture, and garbage collection concepts
OOP principles, inheritance, interfaces, and collections framework
Multithreading, concurrency, and Spring Boot framework basics

skills.name: C++
learning_recommendations: C++ basics, memory management, pointers, and references
Standard Template Library (STL): vectors, maps, iterators, and algorithms
Object-Oriented Programming, templates, and RAII idiom

skills.name: React
learning_recommendations: React Component Lifecycle & JSX fundamentals
State management using hooks (useState, useEffect, useContext, useReducer)
Component modularity, props drilling prevention, and React Router

skills.name: HTML
learning_recommendations: Semantic HTML5 tags and accessible web standards (WAI-ARIA)
Forms, input validation, and media elements
SEO fundamentals and document object structure

skills.name: CSS
learning_recommendations: Box model, flexbox, and CSS grid layout mastery
Responsive web design using media queries and fluid sizing
Transitions, keyframe animations, and CSS variables

skills.name: Tailwind CSS
learning_recommendations: Utility-first styling approach and responsive breakpoint variants
Tailwind configuration, custom themes, and arbitrary values
Component design patterns with utility classes and Tailwind plugins

skills.name: Node.js
learning_recommendations: Node.js runtime architecture, event loop, and non-blocking I/O
Built-in core modules (fs, path, http, events, streams)
NPM package lifecycle, modular code structure, and debugging

skills.name: Express.js
learning_recommendations: Building HTTP servers and routing with Express
Middleware pipeline, request parsing, and error-handling patterns
Authentication middlewares (JWT) and integration with database drivers

skills.name: REST API
learning_recommendations: REST architectural principles: statelessness, standard HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
Proper HTTP status codes, error payloads, and pagination
API contract definition, OpenAPI/Swagger documentation, and Postman testing

skills.name: MongoDB
learning_recommendations: Document database concepts, BSON schema, and CRUD operations
MongoDB Aggregation pipeline ($match, $group, $lookup)
Indexing strategies, data modeling, and Mongoose ODM integration

skills.name: MySQL
learning_recommendations: Relational schema design, normalization (1NF, 2NF, 3NF), and primary/foreign keys
Complex SQL queries: JOINs, GROUP BY, subqueries, and views
ACID transactions, storage engines, and index optimization

skills.name: SQL
learning_recommendations: Fundamental SQL syntax: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
Inner, Left, Right, Full Outer Joins, and aggregate operations
Database indexing, query execution plans, and transaction isolation levels

skills.name: Git
learning_recommendations: Git repository workflows: init, stage, commit, branch, merge, and rebase
Resolving merge conflicts and inspecting logs with git log / diff
Git branching strategies (Git Flow, trunk-based development)

skills.name: GitHub
learning_recommendations: Remote repository management, pull requests, and peer code reviews
GitHub Actions basics for Continuous Integration (CI) automation
Issue tracking, milestone planning, and open-source project management

skills.name: Docker
learning_recommendations: Docker fundamentals: differences between virtualization and containers
Managing images and containers (pull, run, stop, inspect, volumes, networking)
Writing clean Dockerfiles with multi-stage builds and Docker Compose setup

skills.name: AWS
learning_recommendations: Cloud computing fundamentals, regions, and availability zones
Core AWS services: EC2 (Compute), S3 (Object Storage), IAM (Access Management)
Serverless introduction with AWS Lambda and API Gateway

skills.name: System Design
learning_recommendations: Scalability fundamentals: vertical vs. horizontal scaling and stateless architecture
Load balancing, caching strategies (Redis/CDN), and database replication/sharding
CAP theorem, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and microservices patterns

skills.name: Data Structures
learning_recommendations: Linear data structures: arrays, linked lists, stacks, and queues
Non-linear structures: binary search trees, heaps, tries, and graphs
Hash tables, collision handling, and memory trade-offs

skills.name: Algorithms
learning_recommendations: Asymptotic time and space complexity analysis (Big-O, Big-Theta notation)
Searching and sorting algorithms: Binary search, QuickSort, MergeSort
Algorithm paradigms: Divide and conquer, Greedy methods, Dynamic Programming

skills.name: Machine Learning
learning_recommendations: Supervised learning algorithms: Linear regression, Logistic regression, Decision Trees, Random Forests
Data preprocessing, feature scaling, train-test splitting, and cross-validation
Evaluation metrics: Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-Score, and ROC-AUC curve

skills.name: Deep Learning
learning_recommendations: Neural network fundamentals: Perceptrons, activation functions, backpropagation, and loss functions
Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) for image tasks and Recurrent Networks for sequences
Deep learning frameworks (PyTorch / TensorFlow) and regularization techniques (Dropout, BatchNorm)

skills.name: NLP
learning_recommendations: Text preprocessing: Tokenization, lemmatization, stop-word removal, and regex parsing
Vector representations: Bag of Words, TF-IDF, Word2Vec, and contextual embeddings
Transformer architectures, attention mechanism, and BERT / Sentence-Transformers
